title: Google's Gemini cuts video analysis costs by 88 percent
title_candidates: The Gemini feature that watches long videos so you don't have to
How Google's Gemini AI processes an entire long video in one go
What Gemini can do with long videos that most AI tools give up on
How Google cut the computing cost of AI video analysis by 88%
Inside Google's AI that can understand an entire film from start to finish
caption:
Google's Gemini can now watch and understand long videos from start to finish, something most AI tools fall apart on. The company calls it agentic video understanding: the model doesn't just skim short clips. It reads the whole thing and figures out what actually happened, in order.

The same analysis now uses up to 88% fewer computing resources than before, which makes it practical for developers building video search tools, auto-summaries, or anything that needs AI to actually pay attention to footage.
